text: A dragon’s hoard lies near the old quarry.
Monks plan a great fair at week’s end.
The duke will host a grand tournament.
Caravans are stuck at the mountain pass.
Bandits left the valley—roads are safe now.
A miracle crop is curing blights overnight.
Tavernkeeper waters the ale; don’t overpay.
The guild will tax salt next week.
A foreign prince collects rare crystals.
Hunters saw tracks as big as barrels.
